sections.title: Contact Linkfields
sections.subtitle: One strategic partner across your transformation. Tell us about your business requirements and we will connect you with the relevant Linkfields team.

sections.heading: Choose the right conversation
sections.body: For a services or project requirement, product demonstration or software licensing enquiry, contact our sales team. General enquiries go to info@linkfields.com; candidates should use the [Careers page](/careers) and recruitment email below.
sections.secondaryBody: Describe your priorities, current environment and the outcome you need, without including confidential information. We can agree an NDA if needed. Read our [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy) for information about personal data.

sections.heading: Six locations, *one accountable team*
sections.description: Headquartered in South Africa, with our Offshore Delivery Centre in India and offices serving the Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia Pacific. Select an office to see it on the map.

sections.heading: Prefer email? *Write to the right team.*
sections.description: Use the address that matches your enquiry so it reaches the right people first time.

sections.heading: Let’s connect
sections.subheading: Tell us about your business requirements
